subtitle: Lesson 8 · Tokenization & Data Pipelines at Scale

eyebrow: Bigger vocab, fewer tokens per document
code:
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

text = "Tokenization determines how efficiently a model uses its context window."

gpt2_tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("gpt2")                      # ~50,257
llama3_tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B")  # ~128,256

print(len(gpt2_tok(text)["input_ids"]))
print(len(llama3_tok(text)["input_ids"]))
caption: Fewer tokens per document means cheaper attention and more text per context window.

code:
def embedding_params(vocab_size, hidden_size):
    # input embedding + output (unembedding) projection
    return 2 * vocab_size * hidden_size

print(embedding_params(128_256, 4096))  # large vocab
print(embedding_params(32_000, 4096))   # small vocab
caption: Embedding/unembedding cost scales linearly with vocab_size x hidden_size.
